local_inferences: A resolution-heavy maker cohort does not establish state-complete or delta-neutral cash income
Whole-maker versus selected-cohort performance must stay separate; no causal entry eligibility for the persistent cohort is proved
A descriptive full-path regime label must not become a contemporaneous inference feature without prefix-only construction
Executed trade proxies cannot qualify immediate quote fillability, synchronized capacity or a maker's queue position
One realized YES per historical event does not prove all future states are mutually exclusive and exhaustive under the written rules
Nonnegative expected quote rent under model beliefs is not nonnegative realized payoff in every settlement state
The displayed Lemma 1 last inequality conflicts with positive screening-band room; do not import it as an executable gate without resolution

research_decision.causal_maker_abstention_hypothesis: methodological lead only; requires untouched prefix-built episodes and complete cost/inventory paths
research_decision.neutral_target: Cash on completed payoff-matched packages, separated from residual directional inventory and compared against feasible liquidation or no trade
research_decision.binance_target: Funding receipts plus entry/exit basis and native commissions on quantity-matched legs; no direct transfer of this paper's empirical claims to Binance
